notes.title: 10 new levels and achievements
notes.content:
Added new levels, a total of 20 levels and 21 achievements are available in the game.
Large saws and dynamite surfaces appeared on the levels.

notes.title: TV and Door
notes.content:
Added new levels.
In the new update, 10 of the 50 levels are available.
Added teleports-TV sets and transitions to new levels through the door.
Changed the design of the levels and added doors with a timer.
A total of 11 achievements out of 51 are available.
